verdict.rationale: Sketch documents use the open `.sketch` format (a zipped JSON+binary archive) rather than a proprietary opaque format, which supports portability and third-party tooling/git integration per community reports. However, there's no evidence of a full account/workspace-level export tool for bulk data extraction (comments, version history, workspace settings) to enable a clean 'export everything and leave' migration.  missing for 10: bulk workspace/account export feature, documented data-portability/migration guide, independent confirmation of successful full data export.
